[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/crb-requirements.md#purpose]

## Purpose

The CRB review evaluates **conceptual design** documents to ensure business initiatives are justified, strategically aligned, and conceptually sound. This is a business-focused review that occurs before detailed technical design (ARB).

---
page_texts.5:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/crb-requirements.md#what-crb-reviews]

### What CRB Reviews

- **Business problem or opportunity** clearly articulated
- **Expected business value** with quantified benefits
- **High-level conceptual approach** to solving the problem
- **Strategic fit** with enterprise objectives
- **Risk assessment** from business and technical perspective
- **Alternatives considered** and why this approach was chosen
page_texts.6:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/crb-requirements.md#what-crb-does-not-review]

### What CRB Does NOT Review

- Detailed technical architecture (that's ARB)
- Deep technology stack decisions
- Detailed implementation plans
- Production operational details

---
page_texts.7:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/crb-requirements.md#expected-content-style]

## Expected Content Style

- **Business language**: Accessible to non-technical stakeholders (executives, business sponsors)
- **Value-focused**: Emphasizes outcomes, benefits, ROI
- **Conceptual**: High-level approach without technical minutiae
- **Strategic**: Connects to enterprise goals and initiatives
- **Concise**: To the point, avoids unnecessary technical jargon
- **Cohesive**: Clear narrative from problem → solution → value
page_texts.8:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/crb-requirements.md#technology-mentions]

### Technology Mentions

✅ **Acceptable** (at end of document): Technology candidates mentioned for future ARB evaluation

❌ **Not acceptable**: Detailed technical architecture, specific versions, infrastructure sizing, security protocol details
page_texts.9:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/crb-requirements.md#red-flags]

### Red Flags

- Document reads like a technical spec (belongs in ARB, not CRB)
- Business problem is vague or missing
- Weak or missing business value justification
- Strategic alignment is forced or absent
- No alternatives were considered
- Excessive technical jargon
- Disjointed — doesn't tell a coherent story

[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/crb-requirements.md#scoring-dimensions]

## Scoring Dimensions

| # | Dimension | Weight |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Project Information & Completeness | 10% |
| 2 | Executive Summary & Problem Statement | 10% |
| 3 | Business Case | 20% |
| 4 | Conceptual Approach | 25% |
| 5 | Risk Assessment | 15% |
| 6 | Additional Information | 20% |

> For detailed criteria, section mappings, and diagram requirements, see the [processing rules file](../../resources/processing-rules/crb-rules.json).

[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/crb-requirements.md#required-diagrams]

## Required Diagrams

1. **Business Process Workflow Diagram** (Conceptual Approach)
2. **C4 Level 1 — Context Diagram** (Conceptual Approach)
3. **C4 Level 2 — Container Diagram** (Conceptual Approach)

page_texts.12:
[.tooling/components/apis/ai-gov-review-service/docs/review-types/crb-requirements.md#passfail-rules]

## Pass/Fail Rules

- **Overall weighted score ≥ 75%** → PASS (DEFERRED)
- **Overall weighted score < 75%** → FAIL (REJECTED)
- Individual dimension scores are **informational only** — they do NOT independently cause rejection
- Per-section status shows ✅ PASS or ⚠️ CONDITIONAL for transparency, but the overall decision is driven solely by the overall score
